chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Commands the Xingtian Formation - Desolate Era Chapter 21
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning takes command of the Xingtian Formation, shattering expectations and earning first place as a general. Meanwhile, the Seamless Gate completes its war mobilization in the shadows.

og_description: Watch a freakish genius pilot a god-forged war formation to victory while the enemy prepares its final move.
twitter_title: Ji Ning crushes the Xingtian test! #DesolateEra
twitter_description: Ji Ning tops the Xingtian Formation trial, but the Seamless Gate is already mobilizing for war.

lore_anchors.definition: An incredibly hard material mined from the endless Chaos by True Gods and Daofathers. It is used as a benchmark for power calibration in high-tier tests.
A massive war formation requiring 100,000 Loose Immortals and 1,000 Celestial Immortals, manifesting a temporary divine spirit of god-tier durability. Bestowed by the ancient True God, Xingtian.
The highest quality magic treasure tier for weapons within the Grand Xia's known classification system, typically wielded only by Pure Yang True Immortals.
A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power. A high Heartforce level allows for brute-force control of more treasures.
A technique being taught to the defecting Celestial Immortals of the Seamless Gate, suggesting a ritual of conversion or control before battle.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Ji Ning shatter so many more chaotic goldstones than anyone else?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His Heartforce, which he used to brute-force mobilize far more of the Xingtian Formation's Heaven and Earth energy than any other Celestial Immortal could.
It was bestowed by the ancient True God Xingtian. It is a supreme war technique that uses 100,000 Loose Immortals and 1,000 Celestial Immortals to manifest a temporary divine divine spirit.
In Xianxia, it is a realm's accumulated destiny and luck. Losing it makes a world vulnerable to conquest, which is why the Seamless Gate's defection strategy is so effective.
